article.title: Continuing breaches and torts.
article.content: In the case of a continuing breach of contract or in the case of a continuing tort, a fresh period of limitation begins to run at every moment of the time during which the breach or the tort, as the case may be, continues.
article.html:
22Continuing breaches and torts.

Section 22 · Part III, Computation of Period of Limitation

In the case of a continuing breach of contract or in the case of a continuing tort, a fresh period of limitation begins to run at every moment of the time during which the breach or the tort, as the case may be, continues.
